name: horizun-civil3d-mcp
description: Read and make verified writes in local Autodesk Civil 3D drawings through Horizun MCP.

interface.longDescription: Connect to a local Autodesk Civil 3D drawing. Inspect surfaces, alignments, corridors and CAD objects, then apply confirmed edits with post-commit verification.
defaultPrompt: Check the Civil 3D bridge and the active drawing.
Audit this drawing and list the main issues.
Plan a surface edit, then verify the result.
